traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.text: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. The kind of dragon determines the damage type of your Breath Weapon and your Damage Resistance, as well as your appearance.

options.name: Black dragon (Acid)
options.text: Acid damage

options.name: Blue dragon (Lightning)
options.text: Lightning damage

options.name: Brass dragon (Fire)
options.text: Fire damage

options.name: Bronze dragon (Lightning)
options.text: Lightning damage

options.name: Copper dragon (Acid)
options.text: Acid damage

options.name: Gold dragon (Fire)
options.text: Fire damage

options.name: Green dragon (Poison)
options.text: Poison damage

options.name: Red dragon (Fire)
options.text: Fire damage

options.name: Silver dragon (Cold)
options.text: Cold damage

options.name: White dragon (Cold)
options.text: Cold damage

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.text: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

effects.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.text: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select it).

options.name: Drow
options.text: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet. You also know the Dancing Lights cantrip.

options.name: High Elf
options.text: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

options.name: Wood Elf
options.text: Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

effects.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.text: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.text: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.text: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.text: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box, that produces one effect of the spell whenever a creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. You can have three such devices at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.text: You are descended from Giants. Choose one supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use it a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

options.name: Cloud’s Jaunt (Cloud Giant)
options.text: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

options.name: Fire’s Burn (Fire Giant)
options.text: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

options.name: Frost’s Chill (Frost Giant)
options.text: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Hill’s Tumble (Hill Giant)
options.text: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.

options.name: Stone’s Endurance (Stone Giant)
options.text: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

options.name: Storm’s Thunder (Storm Giant)
options.text: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.text: You can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you’re in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

effects.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Skilled is recommended.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.text: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.text: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select it).

options.name: Abyssal
options.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip.

options.name: Chthonic
options.text: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Chill Touch cantrip.

options.name: Infernal
options.text: You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
